comment: Grasp teach point. Position and orientation match manual_control End Link GUI: robot-base frame (m) and semantic A/B/C (deg) where HOME [0,0,90,0,0,0] reads A=0, B=0, C=180. With orientation_c_from_xy, C = atan2(Y, X) from position_robot_m (sensor/table XY). Paste position_robot_m from the GUI after a physical teach; add goal_joints_deg from the status window for reliable planning.
